summary.en: Enterprise-grade AI services on Azure with OpenAI integration and Azure ecosystem.
summary.zh: Azure 上的企业级 AI 服务，集成 OpenAI 和 Azure 生态系统。

title.en: Microsoft Azure AI API Key - Enterprise AI Services | Get Model Key
title.zh: Microsoft Azure AI API Key - 企业级 AI 服务 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Microsoft Azure AI API key for enterprise AI services. Access OpenAI models on Azure with enterprise-grade security.
description.zh: 获取 Microsoft Azure AI API Key，访问企业级 AI 服务。在 Azure 上使用 OpenAI 模型，享受企业级安全。

en: Microsoft Azure OpenAI brings OpenAI models into Azure with enterprise identity, networking, and compliance controls.
You provision an Azure OpenAI (Cognitive Services) resource in the Azure portal, then use resource keys or Entra ID auth per Microsoft Learn docs.
Get Model Key links the Azure create blade only. We do not sell Azure subscriptions or OpenAI resource keys.
zh: Microsoft Azure OpenAI 把 OpenAI 模型放到 Azure 上，配套企业身份、网络与合规能力。
在 Azure 门户创建 Azure OpenAI（Cognitive Services）资源后，按 Microsoft Learn 使用资源密钥或 Entra ID 鉴权。
Get Model Key 仅链接 Azure 创建页。本站不销售 Azure 订阅或资源密钥。

en: Sign in to the Azure portal and open the Cognitive Services OpenAI create experience linked here.
Create an Azure OpenAI resource in an allowed region and wait until it is ready.
In the resource, copy keys or configure Microsoft Entra ID authentication as documented.
Deploy a model and call the Azure endpoint using the base URL and credentials from Microsoft Learn.
zh: 登录 Azure 门户，打开本站链接的 Cognitive Services OpenAI 创建流程。
在允许的区域创建 Azure OpenAI 资源并等待就绪。
在资源中复制密钥，或按文档配置 Microsoft Entra ID 鉴权。
部署模型后，使用 Microsoft Learn 中的 endpoint 与凭证发起调用。

question.en: How is Azure OpenAI different from platform.openai.com?
question.zh: Azure OpenAI 和 platform.openai.com 有何不同？

answer.en: Azure OpenAI runs under your Azure subscription with Azure IAM, networking, and regional controls. OpenAI.com is a separate product path.
answer.zh: Azure OpenAI 跑在你的 Azure 订阅下，具备 IAM、网络与区域管控；OpenAI.com 是另一条产品路径。

answer.en: Check Azure pricing and your subscription meters. This directory does not publish prices.
answer.zh: 请查看 Azure 定价与订阅计量。本目录不公布价格。

question.en: Does Get Model Key provide Azure keys?
question.zh: Get Model Key 提供 Azure Key 吗？

answer.en: No. Keys are created inside your Azure resource after you provision the service officially.
answer.zh: 不提供。你需在官方开通资源后，于自己的 Azure 资源中创建密钥。
